summary: Review-request regression: 11/12 backend tests PASS (1 xfail = confirmed 500 bug on /food/analyze with non-food images). Food search (local+USDA, no FatSecret), food logging CRUD, daily summary totals, AI search all green. Meal-plan generate macros/ingredients match for balanced + carnivore + balanced-w/gluten-dairy allergies (recomputed via nutrition_engine.resolve_food + INGREDIENT_MACROS, within 2 kcal / 0.3g per meal, days within 5% of target_* at the floor). /mealplan/alternate 'similar' swap matches ingredient macros and keeps day within 5%. Frontend food-log screen renders all 4 tabs (Today/Search/Snap/Manual) — but full UI E2E was blocked because /app/frontend/app/login.tsx has no testID attributes, so auth-dependent flows (meal-detail swap, log + persist via UI) could not be exercised by Playwright. API calls from Food Log without a logged-in profile correctly return 403 (user_id missing), confirming server-side gating works but the frontend harness needs testIDs to proceed.

critical.issue: Returns 500 'int() argument must be ... not NoneType' when the image is unreadable / not food (e.g. solid-color 300x300 JPEG). Expected 422 label_unreadable per review spec. Root cause: handler calls int() on a None weight/count returned by the AI parser; needs a null guard before the int() cast around server.py:~6700-6860 and should map to 422.

ui_bugs.issue: No testID attributes anywhere in /app/frontend/app/login.tsx — blocks any Playwright/E2E that must authenticate. Needs login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button.

integration_issues.issue: When app renders food-log without a loaded profile (profile?.id === ''), it calls /api/food/search?user_id= and server returns 403; UI shows a toast 'API Error' plus 'No results for banana'. Not a backend bug (gate is correct) but the frontend should either wait for profile load or send a loud 'please log in' state instead of a vague API Error toast.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — present on multiple screens including login/food-log.
Console warns: 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.'

action_items: Fix /api/food/analyze to return 422 label_unreadable (or 400 with clear message) instead of 500 when the AI parser returns None for weights/count. Add a null-check before int() in the analyze handler (server.py ~6700-6860).
Add testIDs to /app/frontend/app/login.tsx: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button. Without them, no automated agent can authenticate.
Food-log Search tab: block the search request (or show 'Please sign in') when profile?.id is empty, instead of calling /api/food/search?user_id= and surfacing the 403 as a generic API Error toast.
Address deprecated RN props (shadow* -> boxShadow, Image style.resizeMode -> prop resizeMode) across screens — console flags them on every page load.
critical_code_review_comments: nutrition_engine.FoodRules.violations() is the correct single source of truth for allergy/diet gating — my test now uses it directly. Keep that boundary.
/mealplan/alternate correctly uses the 5-candidate loop added this session; the day totals I measured after a snack swap stayed within 5% (balanced: 2719 kcal vs 2759).
FatSecret cleanly removed from server.py (grep -n fatsecret → 0 hits) and food/search now returns a plain array mix of local + USDA sources.

success_rate.frontend: partial — food-log screen renders correctly with all 4 tabs; full E2E blocked by missing login testIDs

seed_data_creation: Deleted meal_generation_events docs for user 2663e0c4-d8b9-4feb-b42a-8b055631ea25 before each generate pass to clear the 4/month cap. Created and deleted one TEST_banana food log entry during /food/log CRUD verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend macro+allergy+swap pipeline is verified (11/12). The one remaining backend bug is /api/food/analyze crashing on unreadable/non-food images (returns 500 instead of 422). Frontend UI could not be exercised past the login screen because login.tsx has no testIDs — add them and re-run E2E for meal-detail swap + food-log search/log flow. Clear meal_generation_events before any new meal-plan generation (4/month cap).
rca_of_issue: Reproduction for /food/analyze 500: POST /api/food/analyze with user_id=2663e0c4-d8b9-4feb-b42a-8b055631ea25 and image_base64 of any valid but non-food JPEG (e.g. PIL Image.new('RGB',(300,300),(200,150,100))). Server log: 'Food analysis error: int() argument must be a string, a bytes-like object or a real number, not NoneType'. Fix: in the analyze handler (around server.py 6700-6860), guard every int(...) / float(...) call against None (prefer int(x or 0) or an explicit 422 raise with detail='label_unreadable' when the AI returns no portion/weight).
